[inferred] (from the 861eb7d source and docs/052, not seen in a game log yet): the 0.3.16 version line (rebase=9; the rest as 0.3.15), the "scene box:" line, the "config probe:" line. atlas-p0-load-rerun3-1127: atlas-p0-4096 on AtlasP0thinG_4096.world (repro atlas-p0-load-thing-4096: --thin --grow-paint, no null terrain cell). The --thin world crashed at 0xC2C1B5 reading 0x40 in p0fix2-1127 twice (Apex crash report), the known null-cell read of Atlas docs/014 §3.2 / docs/017 §2.1. Same job keys and pins otherwise. atlas-p0-load-1126: Boundless Atlas package P0 (boundless-atlas docs/008 §4; Rodney 2026-11-26 lifted the no-large-world-loads rule for these three loads). Run 1 used empty worlds (no lots): the 2048 control loaded the world file but never left the loading screen; the same with the menu dialog handled first (run 4) and with the unchanged lot-free template; cause not named yet (Atlas docs/010). This queue therefore loads THIN worlds: shipped Sunset Valley with its lots in the origin quadrant, the grown area flat and empty. Correctness / discovery, no timing claim; the load time is one sample. Bin state apex (tools/turbo-compat.ts snapshot -> state apex -> restore). PREP (game closed): in boundless-atlas `node tools/world-empty.ts build "<s3m>/game-copy/worlds/Sunset Valley.world" <s3m>/game-copy/worlds/p0/AtlasP0thin_<size>.world --size <size> --thin` for 2048, 4096, 8192; `native/atlas/build.cmd`, copy out/atlas.asi to <s3m>/game-copy/atlas-main3/atlas.asi; back up <Documents>/Electronic Arts/The Sims 3; `node tools/world-gen.ts install game-copy/worlds/p0/AtlasP0thin_<size>.world` (copies to <Documents>/.../InstalledWorlds; nothing goes into the game install except the per-job atlas.asi + atlas.ini that queue.ts removes again). AFTER: `node tools/world-gen.ts install <each> --uninstall`. Each job: menu -> load_world (LiveMode) -> in_world -> ~2 min of camera poses (origin quadrant, far corner, far x and z edges) -> quit. Read from the job log: load step time, "memory" lines (commit / private / largest free MB per step), script errors (scriptErrorsMax 0), crash / hang capture. Read-backs: ts3native version line; atlas.log version line, the physics root line (off for 2048 and 4096, 4096 -> 8192 with read back 0x46000000 for 8192) and the scene quadtree line (2048 depth 6 without the key, 4096 depth 7, 8192 depth 8). Kill criteria (docs/008): a load failure two triage rounds cannot name, or largest free under ~1.2 GB after the load. Job 1 is the control: a FAIL there is the generator, the install path or the harness, not size. REPINNED 2026-11-26 to the master set m1126b (was m1124d / m1124f) with atlas.asi 0.1.1-p0, bytes pinned. The thin 4096 / 8192 worlds still crash until the generator writes the missing terrain cell records (Atlas docs/017 §2); the CAW-made worlds are in queue atlas-p0-caw-1126. Read-backs added 2026-11-26 (rule review): queue.ts logs each merged Default.ini key as read back from the file; atlas.asi 0.1.1-p0 logs the scene quadtree the renderer built (root size and depth; its pointer chain is [inferred], Atlas docs/017 §5, so a miss on that one line with everything else passing is the read-back, not the world).
